title: Version 2.1.131 - Critical Windows Fix and Endpoint Improvements
description: Fixed VS Code extension failing to activate on Windows due to hardcoded build path bug. Also fixed Mantle endpoint authentication with missing x-api-key header.

title: Version 2.1.129 - Plugin Enhancements and Usability Improvements
description: Added --plugin-url flag for fetching plugins from URLs, CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_SYNC_OUTPUT for terminal compatibility, and auto-update for package manager installations. Improved Ctrl+R history search, Gateway model discovery (opt-in), and numerous bug fixes.

title: Version 2.1.128 - UI/UX Improvements and MCP Enhancements
description: Bare /color command picks random color, /mcp shows tool counts, --plugin-dir accepts .zip archives. Updated /model picker with improved UI. Fixed MCP server connection issues and numerous rendering bugs.

title: Version 2.1.126 - Gateway Model Discovery and Project Management
description: The /model picker now lists models from gateway's /v1/models endpoint. Added claude project purge command, improved OAuth flow, and Windows PowerShell 7 detection. Fixed image handling and numerous security issues.

title: Version 2.1.123 - OAuth Authentication Fix
description: Fixed OAuth authentication failing with 401 retry loop when CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1 is set.

title: Version 2.1.122 - Bedrock Service Tier and PR URL Integration
description: Added ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER environment variable, PR URL paste support in /resume search box, and improved /mcp management. Enhanced OpenTelemetry logging and fixed numerous bugs.

title: Version 2.1.121 - Performance Improvements and Plugin System
description: Added alwaysLoad option to MCP servers, claude plugin prune command, and type-to-filter search box for /skills. Fixed memory leaks (up to ~2GB), improved scrolling, and enhanced dialog handling.

title: Version 2.1.120 - Windows PowerShell Integration
description: Git for Windows no longer required - Claude Code uses PowerShell when Git Bash is absent. Added claude ultrareview subcommand for CI/CD, improved /skills menu, and numerous bug fixes.
